newsitem.title: USA: Marlton Tech makes $14.5 mln acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Marlton Tech makes $14.5 mln acquisition.

text.p: Marlton Technologies Inc said Thursday it had agreed to buy DMS Store Fixtures LP in a deal worth more than $14 million as part of its efforts to grow as an exhibit and display supplier.

The company said in a statement it had entered into a non-binding letter of intent to acquire DMS for $14.5 million in cash and up to 2.25 million unregistered shares. The privately-held company of King of Prussia, Pennsylvania supplies fixtures and displays to retailers, department stores and consumer products manufacturers, it added.
Marlton said it will issue two million shares at the closing of the deal and issue the remaining 250,000 when DMS achieves at least $12.5 million in pre-tax earnings during a five-year period.
It said it planned to seek outside financing to make this acquisition.
In 1996, DMS had an operating profit of about $2.8 million on sales of about $30 million, it said.
